activityIds.description: Direct GetYourGuide activity IDs. Each ID opens its activity page and returns full detail fields.
activityIds.title: Activity IDs (optional)

dateFrom.description: Only activities available on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for any date.
dateFrom.title: Available from

dateTo.description: Only activities available on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for any date.
dateTo.title: Available to

departsFrom.description: Numeric departure-city IDs. Copy them from a search page URL.
departsFrom.title: Departure city IDs

durations.description: Filter by duration. Any of: up_to_3_hours, 3_to_5_hours, 5_to_7_hours, full_day, 2_days, 3_days, 4_days, 5_days_plus.
durations.title: Duration buckets

features.description: Filter by features. Any of: private_tour, skip_the_line, small_group, wheelchair_accessible, hotel_pickup, gyg_originals.
features.title: Activity features

guideLanguages.description: Only activities offered in these guide languages, using two-letter codes (en, de, fr, es, it, pt, …).
guideLanguages.title: Guide languages

includeDetails.description: Open each activity page to add full descriptions, highlights, inclusions, exclusions, meeting point, cancellation policy, supplier, and review fields. Turn off for the fastest search-card-only runs.
includeDetails.title: Fetch activity detail pages

interests.description: GetYourGuide interest IDs such as tc-27 (culture & history) or tc-103 (food & drink). Copy them from a search page URL or the available filters.
interests.title: Interest IDs

language.description: Language for titles, descriptions, highlights, and policies.
language.title: Content language

maxItems.description: Maximum activities to return across all queries, URLs, and IDs.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxReviews.description: How many recent reviews to attach to each activity (0 disables reviews). Only used when detail pages are fetched.
maxReviews.title: Reviews per activity

minRating.description: Only return activities with at least this star rating.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

places.description: Numeric GetYourGuide place/attraction IDs (e.g. 2619 for the Colosseum). Copy them from a search page URL.
places.title: Place IDs

priceMax.description: Maximum starting price in the selected currency. 0 means no maximum.
priceMax.title: Maximum price

priceMin.description: Minimum starting price in the selected currency. 0 means no minimum.
priceMin.title: Minimum price

searchQueries.description: Cities, landmarks, or activity keywords to search on GetYourGuide. One search per item, e.g. 'rome', 'eiffel tower', 'food tour paris'. Used for the keyword-search mode.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: Order of search and listing results.
sortBy.title: Sort results

startTime.description: Filter by start time. Any of: morning, afternoon, evening.
startTime.title: Start time of day

startUrls.description: GetYourGuide URLs or activity IDs. Accepts search pages (/s/?q=...), destination/attraction pages (…-l<id>/), category pages (…-tc<id>/), activity pages (…-t<id>/), and bare IDs such as 631866 or t631866. URL query filters are preserved.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)

title: GetYourGuide Activity Pricing & Highlights Extractor Input
